description: Use when the user asks about a competitor's pricing/packaging changes, or wants a recent pricing-change feed. Returns structured pricing/packaging changes IndustryLens has detected — each with a change_type, severity, materiality score, a plain-language summary, and the real detection date. Pass a `competitor` (name or domain) to scope to one company, or omit it for a recent pricing feed. Pass `competitors` (up to 10 names/domains) instead to get a feed per company in one call, each in input order. The feed spans the markets IndustryLens publicly tracks. No other public source exposes structured competitor pricing-diffs like this.

competitor.description: Competitor name or domain (e.g. 'Apollo' or 'apollo.io'). Omit for a market-wide recent pricing feed.

competitors.description: Batch alternative to `competitor`: up to 10 competitor names or domains. Omit `competitor` when using this. Returns one pricing feed per entry, in input order; `since`/`limit` apply to every entry.

since.description: ISO date lower bound for detection (e.g. '2026-01-01'). Defaults to 90 days ago.

name: get_pricing_changes
title: Get recent competitor pricing changes
